DevOps Engineer & Cloud Specialist with 10+ years of experience designing scalable cloud infrastructure, implementing CI/CD pipelines, and automating end-to-end deployment workflows. Strong expertise in AWS architecture, Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, and containerization with Docker and Kubernetes.

Experienced in building reliable monitoring and observability solutions using Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch, and Nagios, along with automation using Python and Jenkins. Proven track record in cloud migration, disaster recovery planning, and performance optimization.

Passionate about improving system reliability, scalability, and engineering efficiency through DevOps best practices and modern cloud-native solutions.
